correctness.rationale: For h≥4, R=h²−h+1, A=ha+1, B=h²a+R and a≥(h−3)R+h+1, exact normalization RA−B=h(h−1)²a>0 shows the minimum cost with residue coefficient s=x+Ry is w(s)=floor(s/R) B+(s mod R)A. The carry/noncarry formula for w(s+a)−w(s) is strictly positive in the claimed parameter region, proving the complete Apéry set on residues 0≤r<a, not just a sampled formula. At a=a0−1 the explicit cheaper (h−2)B at residue R−h violates it, establishing uniform sharpness. Maximal Apéry residues are qR−1 and a−1=qR+t; the source proves their incomparability except at t=R−1, giving the whole PF set and symmetry iff R|a. Comparing the two maxima yields the two Frobenius branches; Apéry summation yields the genus formula. Independently computed Dijkstra residue minima, PF by semigroup membership, F and genus for 180 parameter pairs h=4..8 and five immediate predecessors.
